draft.shortGloss: to give; to do for someone
draft.emotion: warm and friendly, offering something with a smile
notes: When giving to someone of higher status, use 드리다 instead. When someone of higher status gives to you, use 주시다.
After another verb in the -아/어 주다 pattern, it means doing the action for someone else.

senses.definition: To hand or transfer something to another person.

examples.translation: I gave a birthday gift to my friend.

senses.definition: Used after -아/어 to do an action for someone else's benefit.

examples.translation: Mom read a book to me.
